test_procedure: 1. Reconfigure WhatConverts swap rule 230773 to target 4107056354. Do not publish yet.
2. Publish the source change on ONE page first (/ac-repair/) as a canary.
3. Render that page in a JavaScript-capable browser at 1440x900 and 390x844. A non-JS client sees only the SiteGround SG-Captcha stub and yields false results.
4. ASSERT server HTML (JS disabled or same-origin fetch) contains tel:+14107056354 and ZERO occurrences of 4107610932.
5. ASSERT at runtime that wc_swap reads '<pool> .. 4107056354 .. <ruleid>'.
6. ASSERT the visible number and the tel: href are the SAME number at both viewports.
7. ASSERT the mobile CTA is visible and tappable and dials the swapped pool number.
8. Load with ?gclid=...&gbraid=...&wbraid=...&utm_* and ASSERT the wc_client cookie captures the gclid (already proven working today).
9. Only after the canary passes, publish the remaining four pages and repeat 3-8 on each.
10. Re-render all five at both widths and archive the evidence.
